text:
Amelia: Quick design ask — I pushed an update to the stack viewer prototype: changed how collapsed frames behave when zooming and tweaked how correlation IDs are surfaced. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/trace-ui?node-id=42. PTAL for accessibility + copy.

Raghav: looking now. what was the old collapse behavior? we animated height and trimmed stack lines, right?

Amelia: yup — we collapsed to a single-line teaser and animated open. problem: when you zoom (increase font / density) some frames become unreadable and the copy button overlaps.

Jia: accessibility note: each frame toggle needs aria-expanded on the frame button and an offscreen label for the copy icon. screen readers should hear: "Stack frame 3, collapsed, press enter to expand".

Mike: impl note: we can lazy-load the full frame content on expand to avoid layout shift. for the copy action maybe keep an inline icon + an always-visible keyboard shortcut hint (e.g. "C to copy").

design-bot: updated frame interactions in figma page + screenshot: https://imgur.com/example.png
- new rules: preserve single-line teaser width, show copy icon outside text flow, hover reveals full path (tooltip).

Selena: contrast/visibility nit — copy icon currently 60% gray on white. needs 4.5:1 for WCAG AA. also add visible focus ring for keyboard users and an accessible name: "Copy correlation id".

Raghav: agree re contrast. small thing: what string do we copy? full correlation id or shortened w/ expand option? copying full is 1-click, but displays look noisy.

Amelia: proposal: copy full by default, show shortened visually (first 8 + ellipsis) with tooltip: "Full id copied on click". Also debating label: we currently say "Correlation ID" in UI but backend calls it "trace_id". thoughts?

Mike: backend consistency matters. if logs and APIs use "trace_id" I'd avoid introducing new user-facing term unless it's clearer. maybe "Correlation ID (trace_id)" the first time and then just "Correlation ID" elsewhere.

Jia: prefer "Trace ID" for external-facing copy — simpler for users. Internally auth docs can map trace_id = Trace ID. Accessibility-wise both fine if label is explicit.

Selena: whichever label wins, ensure screenreader announcement includes full context: "Trace ID: 1234abcd copied to clipboard". Also mobile focus states differ so test with VoiceOver/TalkBack.

Amelia: decision: change label to "Trace ID" in UI, keep "trace_id" in API docs. we'll annotate in figma. I'll update the copy.

Raghav: export behavior question: when you export a trace CSV/JSON, we should redact any PII in headers/params. also filename pattern recommendation: "trace-{traceId}-{YYYYMMDD}.json". ok?

Mike: yes to filename. for redaction let's add a small opt-in checkbox: "Include request headers and params (may contain PII)" default off for exports.

Amelia: good call. I'll add export checkbox to the modal. also add aria-describedby with the privacy hint.

Jia: keyboard interactions to document for devs:
- Enter / Space toggles frame
- Arrow keys to move between frames
- C to copy Trace ID when frame focused
- Shift+Enter expands all frames in view
(please put in the dev handoff)

Raghav: will add to the ticket. any objections to the tooltip copy text: "Full Trace ID copied"?

Selena: change to "Full Trace ID copied to clipboard" — clearer for screen reader users.

Amelia: noted. thanks everyone. I'll update figma, add the keyboard spec, and open a small PR for the CSS and aria attributes. tagging @design-bot for the figma updates. :pray: 

Jia: thanks — lgtm. :+1:

Mike: lgtm too — will wire up copy behavior in the trace service.

Raghav: adding implementation tasks to the sprint board.

Amelia: final: I'll rename the copy tooltip to "Full Trace ID copied to clipboard" and fix icon contrast to 4.5:1. PR ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Selena: great, also please run a quick VoiceOver pass when PR is ready.

Amelia: will do, thanks all.
